config.err.graph_tidy: check graphTidyMemories and graphTidyUntagged (0-200) and graphTidyProposals (0-20)
config.err.lab_budget: check labRuns (1-10), labRunUSD (over 0, up to 20) and labExperimentUSD (labRunUSD to 200)
config.err.lab_models: labModel and labJudgeModel must be set and differ (so no model picks its own results)
config.err.ledger_session: check ledgerWindowDays (1-90) and sessionRetroDailyMax (0 or more)
config.err.recent_backup: check recentDecisions (0-20) and backupKeep (1 or more)
